correctness.rationale: Exact vertex realizations are given by primary Section 1.2. Permutation centered squares and parallelepiped independent Rademacher terms are elementary exact identities. Catalan-root decomposition proves S=2zCS+zA², A=(1−2z)/(1−4z)^{3/2}, and yields all-n exact coefficient formula. The common centroid is a proved primary premise, separately confirmed by exact enumeration. Factorization proves strict ordering and sharp threshold n=11. The executed standalone exact checker enumerates 23,713 full-tree vertices and 510 signed vertices, verifies 70 generating-function coefficients and 99 dimensions; these tests support but do not replace the proof. No unjustified extrapolation or unspecified numerical assumption is used.

value.rationale: Uniform-vertex inertia is a canonical squared-distance statistic for the three nested Loday realizations. The vertex measures have different combinatorial laws (permutations, Catalan trees, independent edge signs), so convex-body containment does not predict their inertia ordering. The exact Catalan second moment produces a sharp, previously unprovided reversal at n=11, with a geometric reason for asymptotic orders n^4 and n^3. A precise natural cutoff across an infinite central family is substantive even without a broader theorem.
